name: CTO Bot
tagline: Audits how your engineering org is actually running, without touching anything
description: How a software team is really doing usually gets answered by whoever happens to be in the room. This one sends narrow helpers out to the places the evidence lives - tickets, repositories, design files, docs, build pipelines, release records, team channels - and reports back. It only reads; nothing gets changed.
author: asmDevsit
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
